beats.text: Your spouse paid no tax this year. Their unused credits don't have to go to waste. Some of them can move to your return.
The rule: once a spouse's tax is already zero, five credits can transfer. The age amount, the pension amount, the disability amount, the caregiver amount for an infirm child, and tuition.
Example: Lee went back to school full-time, earned nothing, and paid eight thousand dollars in tuition.
Lee needs none of it. Up to five thousand dollars moves to the spouse's return. That's seven hundred and twenty-five dollars off federal tax.
The twist: only this year's tuition can move. Amounts Lee carried forward from earlier years stay with Lee.
Use Schedule two, line three-two-six-hundred, and check you weren't separated at year end.
Next: the Canada child benefit, and why one parent receives it. Follow so you don't miss it.
